metadata.description: Turn a repository into a code map you can walk through: services, calls, events, data stores and traces, drawn as a factory floor of buildings and belts in a zoomable viewer.

plugins.name: codebase-map
plugins.description: Maps a repository's services, shared libraries, calls between services, events, streams and database reads and writes into code-map.json, with pinned traces and example data, and opens it in a zoomable factory-style viewer.
